name: What happens after a mold inspection?

mainEntity.name: What happens after a mold inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a mold inspection, First To Respond Restoration will provide you with a detailed report outlining our findings. This report will include any identified mold growth, areas of moisture intrusion, lab results if samples were taken, and a clear, actionable plan for mold remediation. We will explain the report in full and discuss the recommended steps to safely and effectively remove the mold and prevent its return.
acceptedAnswer.description: After the inspection, you receive a detailed report with findings, lab results (if applicable), and a plan for mold remediation and prevention.
